newsitem.title: USA: E-Z-EM unit says gets FDA microcatheter OK.
newsitem.headline: E-Z-EM unit says gets FDA microcatheter OK.

text.p: E-Z-EM Inc's AngioDynamics Inc unit said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted 510 (k) clearance for the company to market a line of microcatheters intended for angiographic diagnosis of the peripheral vascular system.

The company said the new three French size AngioOPTIC is the first practical diagnostic catheter that size. The catheters are 0.039 inches, or one millimeter, in diameter but have a relatively high flow rate capability and feature a highly radiopaque material so they are easily seen under fluoroscopy, the company said.
Because of their small size, the puncture site seals faster, reducing the need for complex and expensive post-procedure sealing devices, the company said.
